new_venues.editorial_summary: Seventh-floor hotel function room above Bathurst with big windows over the racetrack hill and surrounding farmland. Tall ceilings, plenty of daylight and a plain, neutral palette leave room to style it your own way. A dedicated coordinator and set food-and-wine packages keep planning simple, and guests can stay in the hotel.

Polished resort on a wide coastal property wedged between the ocean and Tuggerah Lake. High-ceilinged event rooms fill with daylight and open to terraces looking over the fairways and water, with native bushland all around. Couples and guests can stay on site for a full wedding weekend; an experienced in-house wedding contact guides the planning.

Classic community-club reception hall in the inner west with a large polished parquet dance floor and a private bridal suite with ensuite. Rooms can be set up several ways and hired exclusively. Handy for guests: free on-site parking, step-free access and a short walk to public transport. The house kitchen serves generous, home-style European-leaning menus.

Cocktail-style wedding reception on a moving harbour vessel, with city lights, bridges and the Opera House drifting past the windows. Packages bundle canapes, drinks, an MC and DJ, and a celebrant can marry you on board. Suits smaller to mid-sized guest lists (about 70 to 160) wanting a lively, memorable day on the water.

Harbour cruise boats with several decks: a formal dining room, a cocktail area, a small lounge bar and an open upper deck for fresh air and skyline views. Vows can be exchanged on the water. Handles anything from a tiny 10-person celebration to around 200 guests and builds packages around each couple.

Brand-new, sleek reception space in Penrith with an open-plan layout that works as a blank canvas for styling. Own bar areas, lighting and sound systems are built in. Very large capacity (about 400 banquet, 450 seated, 750 standing), so it fits big family weddings in Sydney's west; close to transport and hotels.

Modern lakehouse function room beside the Georges River with wall-to-wall windows onto fairways, water and greenery. Wide terraces, several photo spots and a bridal preparation room. Feels calm and private despite being close to the city; catering runs from canapes through plated dinners.

new_venues.address: 4 Pitt Town Bottoms Road, Pitt Town NSW 2756
new_venues.editorial_summary: Country golf estate in the Hawkesbury with a historic house dating to around 1814 for old-world charm. Outdoor ceremonies on landscaped lawns, then a reception room looking over the fairways. Quiet, private and picturesque, with plenty of scenic corners for photographs.

Fifty-acre rural property about 30 minutes from Canberra with formal gardens, tree-lined drives and wide countryside views. Works for elopements through to big celebrations, indoors or out. Relaxed, personal feel with local-produce catering, a styling studio, lawn games and friendly alpacas for photos.

Boutique winery with Spanish-style architecture, a sunny courtyard and a terrace restaurant. Ceremony in the vines, cocktails in the courtyard, then a shared-plates feast with estate wines. Up to 120 guests; an on-site villa sleeps about 15. Warm, social, European-holiday mood.

Elegant 1927 clubhouse tucked beside private bushland, with lots of daylight and a separate sitting room for the bridal party. Ceremonies on clipped lawns and gardens, golf-course photo backdrops, an in-house chef and a coordinator. Seats 180 for dinner or 240 cocktail.

new_venues.service_area: Toms Creek, Port Macquarie Hinterland NSW
new_venues.address: 2001 Toms Creek Road, Toms Creek NSW 2446
new_venues.editorial_summary: Small-scale elopement and micro-wedding retreat on over 100 acres of forest and mountain hinterland. A metal-framed greenhouse pavilion sits among gardens, with ceremony spots including a mountaintop lookout, a green chapel and waterside nooks. Dome accommodation on site turns the day into a private weekend under dark country skies.

Family-run seafood restaurant at Wollongong's Stuart Park with glass doors to a terrace and ocean and lagoon outlooks. Five private rooms from 10 to 600 guests, with packages from about $104 a head. Listing note: recent reviews suggest it may have closed, so confirm trading before publishing.

new_venues.service_area: Little Bay, Eastern Suburbs Sydney NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Golf club on high sandstone cliffs with a sweeping, unobstructed Pacific outlook. The Tasman Room opens onto a large balcony over the sea and the course. About 150 seated or 200 cocktail, with a wedding planner and on-the-day coordinator.

Orange-region vineyard with views across to Mount Canobolas and rolling hills. Private ceremony spots, garden cocktail lawns, a reception hall with big views, fire pits for chilly evenings, and play areas for children. Local chefs cater and rooms are available on site.

style_tags: less than an hour from Sydney
new_venues.editorial_summary: Historic sandstone property from the 1820s in the Mulgoa valley, under an hour from the CBD. Original buildings are paired with modern comforts for ceremony, photos and reception, and three refurbished cottages sleep up to 48 guests. Country elegance with a retreat feel.

Hotel events centre with two rooms: the smaller Terrazza for intimate gatherings and the grand Stella Ballroom for large celebrations. Layouts and menus (cocktail, grazing, shared banquet) are flexible, with staff, AV, parking and wheelchair access included.

All-inclusive club reception covering food, drinks, flowers, DJ and linen, with a grand staircase as the photo feature. Experienced with multicultural weddings and flexible on lunch, plated, buffet or cocktail formats. On-site coordinators handle the details.

new_venues.address: Corner King Street & Vernon Avenue, Eastlakes NSW 2018
new_venues.editorial_summary: Contemporary clubhouse in the Eastern Suburbs with a balcony over the golf course and wetlands, calm and green so close to the city. Coordinators run menu tastings and detailed planning meetings so each wedding feels tailored.

Parramatta restaurant offering exclusive hire for weekend lunches, with a buffet or three-course menu, DJ, dance floor and a belly-dance show. Energetic, party-style atmosphere; groups of about 110 or more can receive a complimentary hotel night.

Long-running harbour cruise fleet hosting weddings for over thirty years. The largest vessel takes about 240 seated or 350 cocktail; the smaller two take 140 seated or 180 cocktail. Licensed bars, parquet dance floors and open decks, with ceremonies on board against the skyline.

Sprawling Hunter Valley resort with ceremony and reception spaces among vineyards and bushland, plus one-to-three-bedroom villas, a golf course, pools, tennis and a day spa. A full wedding weekend can happen without leaving the grounds.

Large Gosford-area hotel and function venue with a cathedral-ceilinged restaurant, several private rooms, an outdoor pool and on-site Thai restaurant. Warm, easy-going feel, very close to the town centre and motorway.

Full-service club in central Orange with three function spaces, a rooftop dining room, and a 77-room hotel next door. A dedicated wedding coordinator, in-house chefs and free parking make it simple to run ceremony, reception and accommodation together.

Bali-influenced resort a short walk from the Tweed Coast beach, with palm-lined pools, cabanas, lush gardens and spa. Self-contained apartments make multi-day destination weddings easy. Tropical, serene and indulgent.

Exclusive-use country estate across 60 private acres with a 12-plus bedroom homestead guesthouse. Function room plus marquee for up to 140, overlooking a small golf course. Designed for a whole weekend: Friday dinner, Saturday wedding, Sunday brunch, in a slow, private setting.

new_venues.vendor_name: The Royal Prince Alfred Yacht Club
new_venues.editorial_summary: Pittwater yacht club with broad water views, headlands and sandy beaches nearby. Waterfront ceremony with an indoor backup, rooms for 40 to 200 guests, and the option to arrive by boat or seaplane. Warm, nautical and a little relaxed.

Function centre with three event rooms for 250 to 300 guests and a long add-on menu: decorations, lighting, photo booths, lolly bars, even fireworks. In-house planners and menus that cater to dietary needs. Suited to larger, party-style weddings.

Beachfront hotel on Manly's North Steyne with high-ceilinged function rooms and ocean outlooks. A private enclosed terrace above the beach hosts ceremonies, and ocean-view rooms with balconies suit bridal preparation. Guests can stay on site.

Modern-chic function room with huge windows over harbour and beach. Seats 110 or 140 cocktail, three tiered packages from about $99 a head, event coordinators and 88 guest rooms. Plenty of photo spots at Newcastle Beach and nearby parks.

Country club in Ingleside bushland with panoramic views over the course out to the Pacific. Ceremony on the course or terrace, then the Pacific Room for 170 seated or 280 cocktail. Scenic and refined.

Northern Beaches golf club overlooking Mona Vale Beach and Warriewood headland, with a dedicated outdoor ceremony spot and bistro. Over 25 years of weddings and a reputation for location, food and service.

new_venues.service_area: Beecroft, Upper North Shore Sydney NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Award-winning golf club with ceremonies on tees or in a gazebo, a terrace over the course and several rooms. The bridal party and photographer get golf carts for pictures. Lush, landscaped, and managed by an events team that tailors each package.

Historic North Shore golf club with an Art Deco clubhouse, an open-air terrace over the fairways, and gardens with ponds, bridges and fountains. Seats 140 or 250 cocktail with a customisable menu from the executive chef.

Heritage property with a rose garden for ceremonies, Victorian-style ballrooms and a tea house for small events. Garden View room takes 90 seated and Garden Court 200 seated (400 cocktail). Catering can be canapes, high tea, banquet or buffet. Recent reviews raise pricing clarity and parking, so confirm details.

Alpine hotel in Kosciuszko National Park with a chapel, a riverside ceremony spot and a mountaintop option via the chairlift. Rooms hold 40 to 250. Free chairlift passes for wedding-party photos, discounted stays and a coordinator.

Hidden tropical garden minutes from the CBD, with a vine-covered gazebo for ceremonies and a heritage 1912 factory building for the reception. Courtyards, fountains and leafy photo corners. Up to 100 guests, packages from about $80 a head with a free decor set.

Historic 1920s Georgian-Mediterranean clubhouse over the links, with a vaulted-ceiling chapel room for intimate ceremonies and manicured gardens outside. Main dining room has a bay window onto the course. Hosts 80 to 260 guests.

Large white-themed ballroom in Liverpool for up to 500 guests, with a waterfall behind the bridal table, a white dance floor and a feature fish tank. Free parking and international menus. Access is by stairs, so check accessibility.

Light-filled, open-plan room on the Central Coast with floor-to-ceiling glass facing the racecourse and a mountain backdrop. In-house chefs and event team customise menus. Convenient from Sydney and Newcastle via the M1.

Five-acre country garden with a lakeside gazebo, a 20-metre wisteria arbour, roses, lawns, woodland, orchard and cutting garden. Formal and intimate garden rooms for ceremony and reception. Couples can bring their own suppliers for a personal, storybook look.

Classic 1899 golf club with timber features, two fireplaces for winter weddings, and two function rooms opening onto a veranda over manicured grounds. Concord Room seats up to 210. Personal coordinator and plenty of parking.

Hunter Valley winery estate in the Broke area with a rose garden, citrus orchard, bushland and cellar door. Weddings with tailored packages, plus riding, yoga and bush walks for guests. French-inspired name; nature-immersed and intimate.

new_venues.address: Corner The Grand Parade & Princess Street, Brighton Le Sands NSW 2216
new_venues.editorial_summary: Beachside hotel on Botany Bay with modern indoor and outdoor function spaces for up to 350 guests and outdoor ceremonies. Friendly team, a dedicated wedding coordinator and sea views.

Oceanfront Italian restaurant opposite Main Beach with arched windows, stone walls, curved timber ceilings and tropical gardens. Seated or cocktail events for 20 to 130. Head chef designs menus around your wishes and the team coordinates suppliers.

Kiama waterfront pavilion metres from Surf Beach, framed by Norfolk pines, with a bridal suite and ocean outlook. Run by Culinarius, a catering company operating since 1988, so food is a feature. Ceremonies can take place at nearby beaches, reserves or churches. Phone and email are the Culinarius office's.
Prestigious golf club 15 minutes from the CBD, with golf-course views from every room. Up to 200 guests, personal planning, fine dining from an executive chef and plenty of on-site parking.

new_venues.vendor_name: Royal Motor Yacht Club Broken Bay
new_venues.editorial_summary: Yacht club on Pittwater with a waterfront terrace for ceremonies, a Top Deck function room with 180-degree water views for up to 200, and smaller rooms for 50 to 80. Guests can arrive by open tender boat. Packages start about $119 per head.

Five-star hotel in The Rocks with classic British-style interiors and harbour-bridge sunsets. The Drawing Room suits small ceremonies, the Ballroom large celebrations, and the Harbour Room has water views. Tastings and meticulous planning from a wedding specialist.
Beachfront hotel opposite Coogee Beach with 13 flexible event spaces (ballroom dinners up to 260), six food and drink outlets, a pool and 210 rooms. Ocean views and covered parking.

Championship golf course setting with waterfalls, gardens and gum trees. Ceremony lawn, sandstone terraces for cocktails, and a hall with open rafters and a big fireplace for up to 180. All-inclusive packages, an adjacent motel, and a feeling of being far from the city.

new_venues.service_area: North Sydney, Lower North Shore NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Hotel with garden surrounds and eastern harbour outlooks, 10 minutes from the CBD. All-inclusive five-hour package covers canapes, four-hour drinks, three courses, cake service, dance floor and a bridal suite night. Fits 60 to 120 guests.

new_venues.address: 1029 St Albans Road, Central Macdonald NSW 2775
new_venues.editorial_summary: Restored 1840s Gothic-style church in bush above the Macdonald River valley, plus a guesthouse with five bedrooms. Indoor and outdoor reception areas, and couples are free to bring suppliers and decor. Moody, rustic and personal.

new_venues.address: Centennial Road & Boronia Street, Bowral NSW 2576
new_venues.editorial_summary: Luxury Highlands hotel with a ballroom of floor-to-ceiling windows facing the golf course and Mt Gibraltar, plus a terrace for pre-reception drinks. Guests sleep on site; a spa, indoor pool and restaurant add to the stress-free feel.

new_venues.address: 4655 Jenolan Caves Road, Jenolan Caves NSW 2790
new_venues.editorial_summary: Wed inside vast limestone caverns or at Carlotta's Arch and Blue Lake, then celebrate at heritage Caves House with a grand dining room and bridal suite. Dramatic, romantic and unlike anything else. Listing says 2025 weddings paused, so check availability.
Golf club function room in the Shire with native gardens and manicured grounds outside. Seats 160 or 300 standing, with banquet catering, a dedicated events team and good-value pricing.

new_venues.address: 41 The Entrance Road, The Entrance NSW 2261
new_venues.editorial_summary: Recently renovated lakefront resort beside The Entrance, walkable to cafes and surf beaches. Pool, spa, sauna and tennis court, and balconies over the lake and pool. Good for guests who want to stay for the weekend.

Exclusive 100-acre property facing Yengo National Park, with exotic and native garden corners, pool-side ceremony settings and four dwellings sleeping 32. Up to 100 guests, a commercial kitchen so you can self-cater or bring your own caterer, three packages (Romance, Elegance, Indulgence) and mid-week discounts.

new_venues.address: 35-45 Shoal Bay Road, Shoal Bay NSW 2315
new_venues.editorial_summary: Freshly refurbished beachfront venue on Shoal Bay with contemporary design and clear waterways outside. Spaces for intimate gatherings up to 500, award-winning menus, and on-site stays including a luxury penthouse and resort apartments.

new_venues.address: End of Stonehaven Road, Stanwell Tops NSW 2508
style_tags: less than an hour from Sydney
new_venues.editorial_summary: Boutique escarpment retreat with ocean views, a sandstone dining room with warm timber and big windows, a glass atrium for ceremonies and a natural-looking pool at the cliff edge. 50 seated or 80 cocktail. Owners Andrew and Sonja are known for warm, personal service.

South Coast guesthouse with lush garden and water surrounds. Ceremony, reception and accommodation are all on site for up to 80 guests, with canape or a la carte catering and an entertainment system. Wheelchair accessible.

Historic homestead with a restored barn on 32 hectares, ceremonies under 180-year-old elm trees and rolling paddocks, all with exclusive access. Farm-to-table catering and warm hospitality from owners Gerry and Ann. Note: ACT, outside NSW.

existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Hunter Valley estate across 120 acres of vines and bush. The Cricketers Pavilion has high ceilings, chandeliers and timber beams, with a veranda dance floor and several ceremony spots. Winter weddings are a feature, with bare vines and open fires. Matches DB phone (02) 4930 9888 and wandin.com.au.
North West Sydney hotel with landscaped gardens and private courtyards for ceremony and reception, spa on site, accommodation, menu tastings and a coordinator. One-stop-shop feel.

Pittwater waterfront hotel with a private jetty and pontoon for photos, a terrace over the water and a panoramic reception room for 50 to 130. Newlyweds get a Waterfront Wedding Spa Suite night. Consultants guide planning.

Award-winning centre above Little Bay with uninterrupted Pacific views from rooms and terraces, an outdoor amphitheatre and a private dressing room. Seats 200 or 250 cocktail. Dry hire so you pick the caterer; the Little Bay chapel is next door.

existing_venue_additions.weddingnsw_name: Dangarra O Badu at Bangarra Dance Theatre
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Light-filled Walsh Bay wharf space with Harbour Bridge views and a harbourside patio, steeped in First Nations cultural heritage. 80 seated, 120 cocktail, four approved caterers.
Beachfront RSL and surf-club venues with newly renovated function rooms, oceanfront balconies and easy flow between indoors and outdoors, plus wet-weather backup. Relaxed seaside feel.

Golf club on the sand at Collaroy with beach ceremonies at no extra charge, alfresco dining and Pacific backdrops. 30 to 240 guests. Alternative contact: hello@longreefgolfclub.com.au (DB has office@).
National-park setting at Akuna Bay with a balcony and a terrace for ceremonies over water and bush, 180 seated or 250 cocktail, LGBTQ+ welcoming. Alternative phone 1800 325 2672.
Southern Bondi icon with ceremonies on the pool deck over the whole beach, a private function room with its own bar and dance floor, and three ocean balconies. Coastal-walk photo spots.

Historic Camden-area estate with an air-conditioned garden marquee for 150, four ceremony spaces (The Views, The Barn, The Palm Garden, The Secret Garden), croquet lawn, fountains, orchard and a three-bedroom homestead. Alternative phone (02) 4655 6582.

Level-2 space above South Maroubra surf club with full-height windows onto the ocean, a private balcony, and beach, balcony or lawn ceremonies. 40 to 250 seated, up to 400 standing. Ceremony fees $500 to $700 and catering from about $100 a head. Alternative contact info@topcatcatering.com.au.

Modern clubhouse bordering Ku-ring-gai Chase with wrap-around verandahs, big windows onto fairways and bush, lawn ceremonies. 160 seated or 250 cocktail; listing quotes roughly $50 (cocktail) to $80 (seated) per head, verify.

Parkland reception centre at Olympic Park offering a garden-wedding feel with indoor reliability, lake and meadow photo backdrops, and Asian and Indian menu options. Note: weddingnsw phone (02) 9763 7833 differs from DB (02) 9764 9900; DB kept.
Boutique hotel opposite Coogee Beach: the Seaview Room (divisible) has French doors to a veranda over the beach; the Seabreeze Room has a garden terrace. Stay on site; beach ceremonies possible.

extra_style_tags: ceremony and reception in one place
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Circa-1810 homestead and working winery in Sydney's south west with gardens for ceremonies and rooms for up to 450 guests. Visits by appointment.
